CustomField.description: Freight - Displays the customer rank visually with 5 being the highest
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Ranking__c, "1"), IMAGE("/resource/1476351092000/onestar", 'One Star'), IF( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Ranking__c, "2"), IMAGE("/resource/1470534573000/twostars", 'Two Stars'), IF( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Ranking__c, "3"), IMAGE("/resource/1476351092000/threestars", 'Three Stars'), IF( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Ranking__c, "4") , IMAGE("/resource/1470534573000/fourstars", 'Four Stars'), IF( ISPICKVAL(Customer_Ranking__c, "5") , IMAGE("/resource/1476433550000/fivestars", 'Five Stars'), ' ' )))))
CustomField.label: Customer Rank
